topics.label: Lecture framing: cancer hallmarks and their genetic basis
topics.groupedBecause: The opening establishes the lecture’s aims and introduces the framework for connecting cancer mutations to functional hallmarks.

topics.label: Signaling mutations that deregulate growth and survival
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in extracellular signaling pathways free cancer cells from normal controls on proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Disrupted differentiation in blood cancers and intestinal epithelium
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics show how the differentiation state of cancer cells explains their abnormal expansion and tissue organization.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how altered p53 signaling and the balance of mitochondrial apoptotic regulators allow cancer cells to evade death.

topics.label: Telomere maintenance and cancer cell immortalization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics connect telomere-dependent limits on cell division to the mutations that enable cancer cells to bypass those limits.

topics.label: p53 stress responses and genome protection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain p53-mediated safeguards against transformation and conclude the discussion of mutation-driven loss of growth control.

topics.label: Cancer metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how altered metabolism supports cancer and participates in self-reinforcing changes to gene regulation.

topics.label: The angiogenic switch in tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains why tumors require new vasculature and how the balance of angiogenic signals enables its development.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and successful colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine what allows tumor cells to spread from a primary site and survive as detectable tumors elsewhere.

topics.label: Closing synthesis, further reading and practicals
topics.groupedBecause: The closing reiterates the lecture’s central takeaway and learning goals before offering further reading and directing students to the practicals.
